name: KFC The Hard Way
summary: Colonel Sanders is known the world over as a fried chicken genius because of KFC. But his genius also drives him to ever more startling heights. His latest endeavour is an escape room he engineered in virtual reality. This was the clearest way to communicate exactly what is expected when it comes to making his fried chicken. And he was at last able to give himself the powers he always wanted. Powers like laser eyes and a robot companion. Enter at your own peril, and see if you have what it takes to make KFC Colonel Sanders’ way, the Hard Way.

name: KFZ
summary: KFZ is a Zombie wave based shooter featuring 9 levels and plenty of Gore

name: KFC Kitchen
summary: Keep the customers coming and the cash flowing as you serve Kentucky Grilled Chicken to hungry hordes. Keep the KFC from crashing to the floor and your customers from heading out the door to make it to the next stage. Each progressive level brings tasty new challenges, like a mashed-potato machine or sides of slaw, to accompany your chicken and keep your fingers clickin’.

name: KFC: Match Out the Yummies
summary: KFC: Match Out the Yummies is a playable advergame by Playable Factory made to promote special KFC offers on the Delivery Hero service. The game is a match-3 type game in which the player has to match 15 chicken wings in 10 moves or less.
